package backend

import (
	"cmp"
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"log/slog"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/Rocketable/platform/internal/rocketclaw/config"
	"github.com/Rocketable/platform/internal/rocketclaw/protocol"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

// equivUnfinishedSQL is 049_hidden_run_entries' refusal predicate for unfinished work.
const equivUnfinishedSQL = `WITH unfinished AS (
    SELECT 'turn ' || id || ' (' || phase || ') of ' || conversation_id AS what FROM active_turns WHERE phase IN ('running', 'delivering')
    UNION ALL SELECT 'background job ' || job_id || ' (' || kind || ') of ' || conversation_id FROM background_jobs WHERE status = 'running'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'shadow turn ' || id::text || ' of ' || child_conversation_id FROM shadow_turns WHERE child_turn_id = '' AND terminal = ''
)
SELECT what FROM unfinished ORDER BY 1`

// equivUnindexedSQL is 049's refusal predicate for visible chats missing from message search.
const equivUnindexedSQL = `WITH visible_chats AS (
    SELECT c.conversation_id FROM managed_conversations c
    LEFT JOIN shadow_bindings b ON b.child_conversation_id = c.conversation_id
    LEFT JOIN external_mcp_sessions p ON p.private_conversation_id = c.conversation_id
    LEFT JOIN managed_conversations parent ON parent.conversation_id = c.parent_conversation_id
    WHERE c.conversation_id NOT LIKE 'cron:%' AND c.conversation_id NOT LIKE 'one-off-cron:%'
        AND b.child_conversation_id IS NULL AND p.private_conversation_id IS NULL AND parent.conversation_id IS NULL
)
SELECT v.conversation_id FROM visible_chats v LEFT JOIN message_search_indexed i USING (conversation_id) WHERE i.conversation_id IS NULL ORDER BY 1`

// TestStateStoreEquivalenceDrain does, through this tree's own code, what an operator and
// the previous binary's startup do before the downtime, so 049_hidden_run_entries will not
// refuse: it runs the startup search and summary backfills, settles the Background Jobs a
// stopped process left running as startup recovery does (scripts are killed) and stops the
// task jobs it resumes as Web's stop does, stops every running turn as Web's stop does for
// a turn no loop has picked up, delivers delivering turns as a resumed worker does, and
// claims and stops pending shadow turns.
func TestStateStoreEquivalenceDrain(t *testing.T) {
	databaseURL := os.Getenv("ROCKETCLAW_EQUIV_DATABASE_URL")
	if databaseURL == "" {
		t.Skip("set ROCKETCLAW_EQUIV_DATABASE_URL to drain a State Store copy")
	}

	ctx := t.Context()
	log := slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(t.Output(), &slog.HandlerOptions{Level: slog.LevelWarn}))
	cfg := &config.Config{DatabaseURL: databaseURL, Workspace: t.TempDir()}
	locked := config.NewLockedConfig(cfg)

	s, err := NewSessionServiceIn(ctx, cfg, log)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, s.Stop()) })

	report := func(label, query string) []string {
		rows, err := queryStrings(ctx, s.db, query, label)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		t.Logf("%s: %d\n  %s", label, len(rows), strings.Join(rows, "\n  "))

		return rows
	}

	unfinished := report("unfinished work before the drain", equivUnfinishedSQL)
	report("visible chats missing from message search before the drain", equivUnindexedSQL)

	// The previous binary's startup backfills.
	require.NoError(t, s.backfillSessionSummaries(ctx))
	require.NoError(t, s.backfillMessageSearch(ctx))

	// A subagent continuation needs a model, so a resumed task job only waits to be stopped.
	notes := &backgroundNotesMock{
		continueSubagentFunc: func(ctx context.Context, _ *backgroundJob) (string, error) {
			<-ctx.Done()
			return "", context.Cause(ctx)
		},
		noteReadyFunc: func(string) {},
	}
	registry := newBackgroundRegistry(s, notes, log)
	s.jobs = registry

	type drainJob struct {
		conversation, id, kind string
		created                time.Time
	}

	jobs, err := queryRows(ctx, s.db, `SELECT conversation_id, job_id, kind, created_at_unix_ns FROM background_jobs WHERE status = 'running' ORDER BY created_at_unix_ns, job_id`, "drain jobs", func(row rowScanner) (drainJob, error) {
		var (
			job     drainJob
			created int64
		)
		if err := row.Scan(&job.conversation, &job.id, &job.kind, &created); err != nil {
			return job, fmt.Errorf("scan drain job: %w", err)
		}

		job.created = time.Unix(0, created).UTC()

		return job, nil
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)

	// The previous binary's startup recovery kills script jobs and restamps task jobs to wait again.
	resume, err := registry.recoverJobs(ctx)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, resume(ctx))

	var failures []string

	for _, job := range jobs {
		path := "startup recovery (recoverJobs) kills a script job"
		if backgroundJobKind(job.kind) == backgroundTask {
			path = "startup recovery (recoverJobs) restamps a task job, then Web's stop (backgroundRegistry.stop, errStoppedByUser)"
			if _, err := registry.stop(ctx, job.conversation, job.id, errStoppedByUser); err != nil {
				path += ": " + err.Error()
			}
		}

		var outcome string
		require.NoError(t, s.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT status || ', note ' || note_state FROM background_jobs WHERE conversation_id = $1 AND job_id = $2`, job.conversation, job.id).Scan(&outcome))
		t.Logf("drain item: background job %s of %s (%s), age %s; path: %s; outcome: %s", job.id, job.conversation, job.kind, time.Since(job.created).Round(time.Minute), path, outcome)

		if outcome == string(backgroundRunning)+", note "+string(noteNone) {
			failures = append(failures, "job "+job.id)
		}
	}

	registry.shutdown()

	// Bridges are created but their loops never run, so nothing resumes or starts a model call.
	publisher := &outboundPublisherMock{PublishOutboundFunc: func(_ context.Context, message *protocol.OutboundMessage) error {
		message.MarkDelivered(nil)
		return nil
	}}

	var manager *threadBridgeManager

	manager = newThreadBridgeManager(locked, s, log, &bridgeFactoryMock{newBridgeFunc: func(bridgeCfg *Config) directBridge {
		bridgeCfg.SessionService, bridgeCfg.RequestRestart = s, &runtimeRestarterMock{restartFunc: testNoopRestart}
		bridge := NewConversation(locked, publisher, bridgeCfg, log)
		bridge.threads, bridge.background = manager, registry

		return bridge
	}})

	type drainTurn struct {
		id, conversation, phase, worker, agent string
		recorded                               bool
		created, updated                       time.Time
	}

	outcome := func(id string) string {
		var phase, terminal string

		err := s.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT phase, terminal FROM active_turns WHERE id = $1`, id).Scan(&phase, &terminal)
		if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
			return "row closed and removed"
		}

		require.NoError(t, err)

		return "phase " + phase + ", terminal " + cmp.Or(terminal, "(none)")
	}

	for round := 1; ; round++ {
		// The worker is the bridge the previous binary's startup (StartActiveTurns) and headTurn
		// give a turn: its run's SyncDestination, else its own conversation.
		turns, err := queryRows(ctx, s.db, `WITH unfinished AS (
    SELECT id, conversation_id, phase, COALESCE(NULLIF(inbound_json->>'SyncDestination', ''), conversation_id) AS worker, created_at_unix_ns, updated_at_unix_ns
    FROM active_turns WHERE phase IN ('running', 'delivering')
)
SELECT u.id, u.conversation_id, u.phase, u.worker, w.conversation_id IS NOT NULL, COALESCE(own.agent, ''), u.created_at_unix_ns, u.updated_at_unix_ns
FROM unfinished u
LEFT JOIN managed_conversations w ON w.conversation_id = u.worker
LEFT JOIN managed_conversations own ON own.conversation_id = u.conversation_id
ORDER BY u.created_at_unix_ns, u.id`, "drain turns", func(row rowScanner) (drainTurn, error) {
			var (
				turn             drainTurn
				created, updated int64
			)
			if err := row.Scan(&turn.id, &turn.conversation, &turn.phase, &turn.worker, &turn.recorded, &turn.agent, &created, &updated); err != nil {
				return turn, fmt.Errorf("scan drain turn: %w", err)
			}

			turn.created, turn.updated = time.Unix(0, created).UTC(), time.Unix(0, updated).UTC()

			return turn, nil
		})
		require.NoError(t, err)

		shadows, err := queryStrings(ctx, s.db, `SELECT DISTINCT child_conversation_id FROM shadow_turns WHERE child_turn_id = '' AND terminal = '' ORDER BY 1`, "drain shadows")
		require.NoError(t, err)

		if len(turns) == 0 && len(shadows) == 0 || round > 10 {
			break
		}

		for _, turn := range turns {
			var (
				bridge *Bridge
				path   string
			)

			if turn.recorded {
				bridge, err = manager.recordedBridge(ctx, turn.worker)
				require.NoError(t, err, "turn %s of %s", turn.id, turn.conversation)

				path = "worker " + turn.worker + " (recorded): the bridge startup resumes it on"
			} else {
				// The previous binary's startup skips a worker with no managed row ("active turn worker
				// conversation is not recorded"), and only that worker's headTurn finds the turn, so no
				// bridge ever resumes it and Web's stop cannot reach it. Its stop path needs a bridge for
				// that worker, built as ensureThreadBridge builds one, without the recorded check.
				bridge = manager.factory.newBridge(&Config{ConversationID: turn.worker, Agent: turn.agent}).(*Bridge)
				bridge.threads = manager
				path = "worker " + turn.worker + " (NOT recorded: startup skips it, so it never resumes): a bridge for the worker, built as ensureThreadBridge would"
			}

			if turnPhase(turn.phase) == turnDelivering {
				request, ok, err := bridge.headRequest(ctx)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.True(t, ok)

				path += "; resumed delivery (headRequest, deliver, closeTurn)"
				if err := bridge.deliver(ctx, &request, request.delivery, 0); err != nil {
					path += ": " + err.Error()
				}
			} else {
				path += "; Web's stop of a turn no loop holds (InterruptActiveTurn, stopIdleTurn: finishTurn stopped, deliver, closeTurn)"
				bridge.InterruptActiveTurn()
			}

			result := outcome(turn.id)
			t.Logf("drain item: turn %s (%s) of %s, created %s (age %s), last updated %s; path: %s; outcome: %s", turn.id, turn.phase, turn.conversation,
				turn.created.Format(time.RFC3339), time.Since(turn.created).Round(time.Minute), turn.updated.Format(time.RFC3339), path, result)

			if strings.HasPrefix(result, "phase "+string(turnRunning)) || strings.HasPrefix(result, "phase "+string(turnDelivering)) {
				failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf("turn %s (round %d)", turn.id, round))
			}
		}

		// Pending manifests of a stopped parent turn were stopped with it; any left belong to ended
		// parents, so each shadow claims its next manifest as its worker would and is stopped.
		if len(turns) > 0 {
			continue
		}

		for _, child := range shadows {
			claimed, ok, err := s.claimShadowTurn(ctx, child)
			require.NoError(t, err)

			if !ok {
				t.Logf("drain item: shadow %s; path: claimShadowTurn; outcome: pending manifest cannot be claimed", child)
				failures = append(failures, "shadow "+child)

				continue
			}

			bridge, err := manager.recordedBridge(ctx, child)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			bridge.InterruptActiveTurn()
			t.Logf("drain item: shadow turn %s of %s; path: claimShadowTurn, then Web's stop (InterruptActiveTurn, stopIdleTurn); outcome: %s", claimed.id, child, outcome(claimed.id))
		}
	}

	t.Logf("drain items that did not stop: %v", failures)
	t.Logf("drained %d unfinished items", len(unfinished))
	require.Empty(t, report("unfinished work after the drain", equivUnfinishedSQL), "049_hidden_run_entries would refuse")
	require.Empty(t, report("visible chats missing from message search after the drain", equivUnindexedSQL), "049_hidden_run_entries would refuse")
}
